Lassen College is creating pathways to opportunity [image: Lassen College is creating pathways to opportunity right here in Northern California! Students can explore career-focused programs in agriculture, fire technology, nursing, automotive technology, welding, child development and more—or pursue degrees and transfer opportunities to continue their education. And here’s a fun fact: Lassen College has owned and operated Coppervale Ski Area since the 1940s, offering ski instruction and outdoor recreation for the community. From the classroom to the slopes, Lassen is a special part of this region! #LassenCollege #CoppervaleSkiArea #Susanville #HigherEducation #CareerTraining #StudentSuccess #NorthernCalifornia #58Counties1California @lassencollege @visitsusanville]

Marie Vernon founded Adult Work Experiences to hel [image: Marie Vernon founded Adult Work Experiences to help neurodivergent adults build job skills, gain real workplace experience, and connect with employers. That kind of opportunity can support greater independence and a stronger financial future. That’s one reason I’m proud of California’s CalABLE program. Eligible Californians with disabilities can save for qualified expenses in a tax-advantaged account while protecting eligibility for certain public benefits. Work opportunities and financial tools can go hand in hand in helping people plan for the future. Thank you, Marie, for helping open doors to meaningful work and greater independence. #AdultWorkExperiences #Neurodiversity #InclusiveEmployment #DisabilityInclusion #CalABLE #FinancialEmpowerment]
